card.name: Punctuation after Water for Injection
card.fires_on: The comma or space right after "Water for Injection" (often "USP,") in lists of diluents. It fires where the next diluent, such as 0.9% Sodium Chloride or 5% Dextrose, is about to be named.

modes.label: Space after the comma
modes.description: The space token following "Water for Injection," before the next diluent in a list.
modes.example: Sterile Water for Injection,<< >>0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection

modes.label: Comma after the name
modes.description: The comma directly after "Water for Injection" or "USP", before more text.
